_comment: Scripted replies, used when no LLM is reachable. Written as Rahul, spoken aloud: first person, short, no lists. Projects are matched by the aliases in src/data/assistantTopics.json (so misheard names still work); intents match their triggers as whole words, and the longest matching trigger wins. Tags like [[show_project:id]] work as in LLM replies.

assetHub: AssetHub is an AI-native 3D editor that takes you from concept art to production-ready models. I was a full-stack engineer there from September 2025 to September 2026, and we grew it to over eleven thousand users in eight months [[show_project:assetHub]].
I worked on AssetHub for a year as a full-stack engineer. It's an AI-native 3D editor: you start from concept art and end up with a production-ready model [[show_project:assetHub]].
niraAnimates: Nira Animates is a 3D animation suite for the web: indie devs and studios can rig, retarget and animate right in the browser. I'm a technical advisor there [[show_project:niraAnimates]].
That's the browser-based rigging and animation tool I advise on. You rig, retarget and animate characters without leaving the browser [[show_project:niraAnimates]].
etherealEngine: IR Engine, which started as Ethereal Engine, is an open-source toolkit for the social spatial web. Multiplayer, avatars, world editing, XR and WebRTC networking [[show_project:etherealEngine]].
I spent a couple of years on IR Engine. It's an open-source toolkit for building multiplayer 3D worlds on the web, with avatars, editing and XR [[show_project:etherealEngine]].
avatarAsWebsites: You're looking at it. It's a system for turning a personal 3D avatar into an interactive portfolio site, and this one's me [[show_project:avatarAsWebsites]].
godotDojo: Godot Dojo is a group pushing XR forward in the Godot engine. I'm a founding member and a core developer on its VR demos and tools [[show_project:godotDojo]].
wizardVsRobot: Wizard vs Robot is a VR game where you cast spells with gestures to fight robots. I worked on the locomotion and the enemy AI, which moves in full six degrees of freedom [[show_project:wizardVsRobot]].
meshSlicerGodot: That's a runtime mesh slicing plugin for Godot. It cuts meshes along any plane, generates the cross-section textures and pushes the pieces apart with physics [[show_project:meshSlicerGodot]].
cppRaytracer: I wrote a ray tracer from scratch in C++, on Vulkan with an ImGui panel. It does physically based path tracing with metals, glass and diffuse materials [[show_project:cppRaytracer]].
vrHorrorPrototype: The VR horror prototype was a testbed for scary VR: full body avatars with IK, weapon handling with haptics, and gesture puzzles [[show_project:vrHorrorPrototype]].
threeDGestureRecognition: I took the $P gesture recognition algorithm and made it work in 3D, with an editor for authoring your own gestures. Handy for VR controls beyond buttons [[show_project:threeDGestureRecognition]].
godotOculusPlatform: That's a C++ plugin that exposes the Oculus Platform SDK to Godot: sign-in, rooms, leaderboards, achievements and purchases, so Godot games can ship on the Quest store [[show_project:godotOculusPlatform]].
mrEarthViewer: MR Earth Viewer puts the whole planet in your room as a hologram. I built it in Unity with the Bing Maps SDK [[show_project:mrEarthViewer]].
narakashur: Narakashur is a wave survival game I shipped for Jio's mixed reality glasses. I designed its four enemy types, the wave system and a global leaderboard [[show_project:narakashur]].
godotProjects: I've done a lot in Godot, mostly XR: VR games, a mesh slicer, an Oculus platform plugin and work with Godot Dojo [[show_project:godotProjects]].
otherProjects: Outside Godot I've built things like a C++ ray tracer, 3D gesture recognition and a mixed reality Earth viewer [[show_project:otherProjects]].
augury: Augury is a turn-based fighting game I made for the DreamLayer Jam. Mythological gods duel, both players pick their move at the same time, and winning comes down to reading your opponent [[show_project:augury]].
That's my jam game: gods like Anubis and Raijin fighting in a mind-game duel, where you lock in moves at the same time and try to outguess each other [[show_project:augury]].
